title: Fleet Overview - All Instances

panels.title: Monitoring visibility
panels.description: Inventory is exported for every configured instance, even when SQL is unreachable. If the collector or Prometheus is unavailable, fleet visibility is incomplete; counts are not proof of a healthy fleet.

targets.expr: max(up{job="data-eyes"}) or vector(0)
(count(max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}))) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)

(count(((max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_overall_severity{environment=~"${environment:regex}"})) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1)) == 0) or (count(max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"})) * 0)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)

(count(((max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_overall_severity{environment=~"${environment:regex}"})) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1)) == 2) or (count(max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"})) * 0)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)

(count(((max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_overall_severity{environment=~"${environment:regex}"})) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1)) == 3) or (count(max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"})) * 0)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)

(count((max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 0) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_collection_fresh{environment=~"${environment:regex}",collector="connection"}) == 1)) or (count(max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"})) * 0)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)

(count((max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"})) unless on(environment,sql_instance) (((max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_overall_severity{environment=~"${environment:regex}"})) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1) != 1) or ((max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 0) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_collection_fresh{environment=~"${environment:regex}",collector="connection"}) == 1)))) or (count(max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"})) * 0)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)

panels.title: Warning / critical checks
panels.description: Per-server check severities; thresholds come from collector configuration, not dashboard constants.

targets.expr: sort_desc(((count by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"${environment:regex}"} >= 2) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * 0)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))

panels.title: Unknown checks
panels.description: Per-server check severities; thresholds come from collector configuration, not dashboard constants.

targets.expr: sort_desc(((count by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"${environment:regex}"} == 1) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * 0)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))

sort_desc((((max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sql_cpu_pct{environment=~"${environment:regex}"})) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_collection_success{environment=~"${environment:regex}",collector="resources"}) == 1) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))

sort_desc((((max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_os_cpu_pct{environment=~"${environment:regex}"})) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_collection_success{environment=~"${environment:regex}",collector="resources"}) == 1) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))

sort_desc((((max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_available_memory_bytes{environment=~"${environment:regex}"})) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_collection_success{environment=~"${environment:regex}",collector="memory"}) == 1) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))

panels.title: SQL process memory / target
panels.description: Process memory and SQL target measure different scopes; this ratio can exceed 100%.

targets.expr: sort_desc((((100 * max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sql_memory_bytes{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) / (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_target_memory_bytes{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) > 0)) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_collection_success{environment=~"${environment:regex}",collector="memory"}) == 1) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))

sort_desc((((min by (environment,sql_instance) (100 * max by (environment,sql_instance,drive) (data_eyes_volume_free_bytes{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) / (max by (environment,sql_instance,drive) (data_eyes_volume_size_bytes{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) > 0))) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_collection_success{environment=~"${environment:regex}",collector="databases"}) == 1) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))

sort_desc((((sum by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_database_size_bytes{environment=~"${environment:regex}"})) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_collection_success{environment=~"${environment:regex}",collector="databases"}) == 1) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))

sort_desc((((sum by (environment,sql_instance) (rate(data_eyes_batch_requests_total{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_collection_success{environment=~"${environment:regex}",collector="resources"}) == 1) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))

sort_desc((((sum by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_active_requests{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_blocked_sessions{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * 0)) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_collection_success{environment=~"${environment:regex}",collector="activity"}) == 1) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))

sort_desc((((max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_blocked_sessions{environment=~"${environment:regex}"})) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_collection_success{environment=~"${environment:regex}",collector="activity"}) == 1) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))

sort_desc((((100 * max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_workers_created{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) / (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_workers_max{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) > 0)) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_collection_success{environment=~"${environment:regex}",collector="resources"}) == 1) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))

sort_desc((((sum by (environment,sql_instance) (rate(data_eyes_io_bytes_total{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_collection_success{environment=~"${environment:regex}",collector="io"}) == 1) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))

panels.title: Weighted I/O latency
panels.description: Total stall seconds / total operations. Idle disks have no measured latency, not zero latency.

targets.expr: sort_desc((((sum by (environment,sql_instance) (rate(data_eyes_io_stall_seconds_total{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (environment,sql_instance) (rate(data_eyes_io_operations_total{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_collection_success{environment=~"${environment:regex}",collector="io"}) == 1) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))

panels.title: Wait seconds / second
panels.description: Concurrent waits may exceed one second per second.

targets.expr: sort_desc((((sum by (environment,sql_instance) (rate(data_eyes_wait_seconds_total{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_collection_success{environment=~"${environment:regex}",collector="waits"}) == 1) and on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1)) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))

panels.title: Events in selected time range
panels.description: Counter increases over the selected window; extrapolation can produce fractional counts. Missing event history remains unavailable.

targets.expr: sort_desc(((sum by (environment,sql_instance) (increase(data_eyes_check_events_total{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}[$__range]))) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))

panels.title: Successful collection groups
panels.description: Includes metric groups, connection and enabled health checks. Check count varies with configuration.

targets.expr: sort_desc(((sum by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_collection_success{environment=~"${environment:regex}"})) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))

panels.title: Oldest successful collection age
panels.description: Includes checks scheduled hourly/daily; age alone is not a failure. Use Deep Dive freshness and success indicators.

targets.expr: sort_desc(((max by (environment,sql_instance) (time() - data_eyes_collection_last_success_timestamp_seconds{environment=~"${environment:regex}"})) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)) or on(environment,sql_instance) (max by (environment,sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) * (0/0)))
